papers.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been promising in single-turn LLM fine-tuning. papers.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
papers.summary: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. papers.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.summary: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. papers.summary: As large language models become increasingly widespread, third-party providers that deploy open-weight models have become an important part of the ecosystem. papers.summary: Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition.
